sections.text: These are starting candidates, not measured recommendations for your tasks. RDF, Java, React, source-language and review work are example benchmark areas. Evaluate the tasks your project actually needs.

sections.label: Gap review: workflow use and checks
sections.text: Use this dated candidate table as an entry point when comparing options and planning a costed experiment, after refreshing the applicable rates and access. The 2 October 2026 prices, candidate availability and model labels in the original table were not reaudited in this gap review. They must not be treated as verified current quotations or performance rankings.
